listing.name: Omega Core Everywhere
listing.summary: Omega cores drop from destroyed Omega ships
listing.aiSummary: Adds Omega core drops from destroyed ships and unique effects for Omega cores installed in colony buildings.

description:
Omega Core Everywhere

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- Omega cores drop from destroyed Omega ships
- An Omega core in a colony building finally does something. Usually something absurd.

Production buildings make twice as much for half the demand, at double the upkeep.
Every other building gets an Omega effect of its own, from doubled patrol fleets to stations that shrug off disruption.
Covers the base game, Industrial Evolution, AoTD Vaults of Knowledge and Terraforming & Station Construction. None of them is required but works when that mod is enabled

The code is fully open source. You don't have to credit me. Claude Code built this anyway.
Requires LunaLib.

Omega Core Drops
A destroyed Omega ship can drop the Omega core that commanded it, the same way Alpha, Beta and Gamma cores drop from AI ships.
Bigger ships drop it more often: 33% for a frigate, 66% for a destroyer, 99% for a cruiser, always for a capital.
The chance can be changed, or drops switched off, in LunaLib's settings.

Omega Cores In Colony Buildings
Install an Omega core like any other AI core, on any building that takes one.
Production buildings: production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2.
Everything else: an effect of its own, listed below. These keep the usual -25% upkeep of an AI core.

Settings
In LunaLib's settings menu (Shift+F2 in the campaign): Omega core drops on or off, the drop chance, and building effects on or off.

Base Game Buildings
Building Omega core Effect
Farming, Aquaculture, Mining, Refining, Light Industry, Heavy Industry, Orbital Works, Fuel Production, Cryosanctum Production Production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2
Population & Infrastructure Unique Population growth x2, after every other modifier. A shrinking colony does not shrink faster.
Spaceport / Megaport Unique 1,000 crew into storage every month
Patrol HQ / Military Base / High Command Unique Fleet size x2
Ground Defenses / Heavy Batteries Unique Ground defenses x10, and 500 marines into storage every month
Tech-Mining Unique Finds +100%
Commerce Unique Colony income x2
Orbital Station / Battlestation / Star Fortress Unique Recovers from disruption at once, as soon as the battle is over. Always 100% combat readiness.
Planetary Shield Unique Every building on the colony recovers from disruption at once
Waystation Unique 1,000 each of fuel, supplies, heavy machinery, metals and food into storage every month
Lion's Guard HQ, Cryorevival Facility No effect Only the usual -25% upkeep

Industrial Evolution buildings
Building Omega core Effect
Specialized Mining, Specialized Refining, Salvage Yards Production Production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2
Variable Manufactory / Variable Assembler Production Production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2, and the monthly batch into storage is doubled
Commodity Forge Unique Monthly batch x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2
Centralization Bureau Unique Counts matching buildings on your colonies within 100 light-years, up to 8 of each. Production and demand both rise.
Supercomputer Unique Income x1.5 for every colony you own in the star system, once per system. The core never burns out.
Embassy Unique Reputation with the ambassador's faction is held at maximum
Restoration Docks Unique Every ship placed inside is fully restored at once, for free
Academy Unique Officers in your fleet and in its storage get the experience for their maximum level (you pick the skills) and learn Omega Tutelage: their ship's time runs 20% faster. Your administrators learn Hypercognition.
Museum Unique Museum income x2
Orbital Artillery (mortar, missile, railgun) Unique Fires twice as often. Its station always fights at 100% combat readiness.
Senate, Engineering Hub, Courier Port, Privateer Base, Animal Center, Rift Generator, Requisitions Centre, Hull Deconstructor, Hull Forge, Ancient Laboratory, Specialized Government No effect Only the usual -25% upkeep

AoTD Vaults of Knowledge buildings
Building Omega core Effect
Monoculture Plots, Subsidised Farming, Artisanal Farming, Fishing Harbour, Extractive Operation, Plasma Harvester, Mining Megaplex, Smelting, Crystalizator, Enrichment Facility, Light Production, High-tech Industry, Neurochemical Laboratory, Commercial Manufactory, Fuel Refinery, Civilian Heavy Production, Orbital Skunkworks Facility, Orbital Fleetwork Facility, Macro-Industrial Complex, Garden of Elysium Production Production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2
Resort Center Unique Colony income x2, hazard rating -25%
Terminus Unique Accessibility raised to 1,000%
Trade Outpost / Underworld Unique No stability penalty from the building, colony income x2
Research Facility / Black Site Unique Research 4x as fast (once, however many you have). 10 research databanks into storage every month.
Exomatter Processing Unique A batch takes 5 days and yields 4 Tenebrium Cells
Star Citadel (Low Tech / High Tech) Unique Recovers from disruption at once, as soon as the battle is over. Always 100% combat readiness.
Daedalus Array, Hypershunt Control, Persean Technology Institute No effect Only the usual -25% upkeep

Terraforming & Station Construction buildings
Building Omega core Effect
Hydroponics, Cloning, Cryosanctum, Domain Archaeology Production Production x2, demand x0.5, upkeep x2
Mesozoic Park Unique Park income x2
Genelab Unique Mesozoic Park income x2 more, on top of the Genelab's own boost
Limelight Network Unique Network income x2, and the colony's production is no longer lowered by 1
Domed Cities Unique Stability +7
Kletka Simulator Unique One Alpha core into storage every month, on top of its own monthly roll
AI Mining Drones Unique Mining +5 (station colonies, as in TASC)
Harmonic Damper Unique Ground defenses x10
Autonomous AI Battlestation Unique Recovers from disruption at once, as soon as the battle is over. Always 100% combat readiness.
CHAMELEON No effect Only the usual -25% upkeep

FAQ
Does this mod make Omega cores drop without Astral Ascension?
Yes. That is half of what it is for. A destroyed Omega ship can drop its core: 33% for a frigate, up to always for a capital. The chance is in LunaLib's settings.
And with Astral Ascension installed?
Astral Ascension keeps control of the drops and this mod's drop settings do nothing. The building effects work either way.
And with Astral Ascension Renewed?
They work together: Astral Ascension Renewed adds the Omega core administrator and colonies past size 10, this mod covers the buildings. This mod's drop settings are used.
The core picker still says "No effect" for the Omega core.
That is right for the buildings marked "No effect" above. Anywhere else, a Starsector update has probably changed the picker; the building's tooltip then shows the effect under an "Omega core" heading.
Do I need Industrial Evolution, Vaults of Knowledge or TASC?
No. Their buildings only get Omega effects while that mod is installed. TASC is supported in its AoTD version.
Do bonuses stack?
Yes, and they multiply. Commerce and a Resort Center on one colony give colony income x4; Ground Defenses and a Harmonic Damper give ground defenses x100.
Can I add it to an existing save?
Yes.
Can I remove it from a save?
Yes. The building effects come off before every save, so the save does not depend on this mod. Everything already handed out stays: delivered goods, officer levels, Hypercognition, restored ships and reputation.
Why can the Maglev Central Hub not take an Omega core?
Vaults of Knowledge does not let any AI core into it, so there is nothing to put the Omega core into.

Credits
Omega core drops were first done by Astral Ascension by Planetace. This mod is written from scratch and uses none of its code.

Version log
1.0.0 - long effects get a shorter wording in the core picker, with the full text in the building's tooltip. Production buildings no longer say the facility struggles to keep up.
0.2.1 to 0.2.4 - the core picker and building tooltips show the Omega core's effect instead of "No effect".
0.2.0 - first release: Omega core drops, Omega core effects in colony buildings for the base game, Industrial Evolution, Vaults of Knowledge and TASC, and the fix for the Industrial Evolution Supercomputer crash.
